items.title: Amazon's $100-a-day Full-Funnel campaigns hand targeting to AI, ADOTAT says
items.excerpt: Full-Funnel Campaigns are live for US advertisers while DVA+, which keeps the DSP controls, sat in closed beta. ADOTAT asks who grades results Amazon optimized.

items.title: Salesforce's Hunter agent gets Demandbase intent data with no extra contract
items.excerpt: Sales Cloud teams get buying group, intent and engagement signals inside Hunter's pilot. No price, GA date or data limits are given. What does the deal cover?

items.title: Google's Universal Cart reaches US shoppers as Meta flips browsing on
items.excerpt: Google's Universal Cart went live in US Search and Gemini, while Meta set in-app product browsing to switch on by default in existing ads on October 28, 2026.

items.title: Devising A New (Ad) Metric System; Where Did All The UTMs Go?
items.excerpt: The fight over standardized metrics; UTM parameters no longer appear in ChatGPT results; and the ad agency that's been spying on online users.

items.title: Google Tests Ads in AI Mode for Personal Intelligence Users
items.excerpt: Google is testing ads in AI Mode that can be personalized with inferences from the Gmail and Google Photos data people connect through Personal Intelligence; ads will not draw directly on inboxes, but those inferences may shape which ads appear.

items.title: Here's How ChatGPT Is Targeting You With Ads
items.excerpt: Following 404 Media's tests, Gizmodo explains how advertisers can target ChatGPT ads by prompt context plus email address, phone number or device identifier.

items.title: National Trust pulls TikTok ads after platform’s AI publishes unauthorised videos — Tomorrow's Publisher
items.excerpt: The charity has suspended its TikTok advertising while it investigates how AI-generated promotional material went live without approval.

items.title: National Trust shuts off all campaigns amid TikTok AI advertising mistake
items.excerpt: A run of AI-generated TikTok ads promoting National Trust membership has led the charity to suspend its advertising on the platform.

items.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
items.excerpt: Online roadblocks are undermining the narrative behind AI agents.

items.title: Ecommerce confronts AI shopping agents ahead of holiday season
items.excerpt: Cheq, a cybersecurity company that verifies AI shopping agents, says it recorded a 100x surge in agentic traffic.

items.title: American Express launches framework to verify AI shopping agent purchases
items.excerpt: American Express aims to reduce payment disputes by documenting what shoppers authorize before AI agents make purchases, including when an agent makes an ordering mistake.

items.title: Google Ads Adds Search Terms and Ad Combinations Report for AI Max
items.excerpt: Google Ads tests a new Search terms and ad combinations report for AI Max campaigns, giving PPC advertisers transparency into queries, copy, and landing pages.

items.title: TikTok Shop Rolls Out Automated Ad Tool And Subscription Feature For UK Sellers
items.excerpt: TikTok Shop added a slate of new seller tools in the UK this month, including an automated advertising program that reinvests sales into ad spend without manual top-ups and a subscription feature that lets buyers set up recurring purchases, according to the platform’s latest Product Pulse update. items.title: Over 40% of Americans have felt duped by AI ads before, new survey suggests
items.excerpt: More than half said they do not trust products advertised with AI to match their descriptions.

items.title: Meta Adds 15 Always-On Topics to Reels Trending Ads
items.excerpt: Meta now offers 15 always-on standard topics in Reels Trending Ads, the format that uses AI to place an ad immediately after top-trending creator Reels.

items.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
items.excerpt: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees.
